I recommend this game [i]but with some caveats[/i]. First, unlocking all the content requires money for either the characters themselves or to buy diamond bundles (or you can use a trainer to add them) to unlock everyone. Second, this is very much a mobile game because everything takes time unless you use diamonds to buy permanent boosts to speed things up or just skip some waits completely.

That said, it's better than most mobile games and certainly top tier compared to other mobile dating sims. The characters are attractive, they have distinct personalities and tastes, and for the patient it can be quite rewarding.

I rarely do this, but I'm changing my review to recommend, just barely.  I'll leave the initial negative review below, because I still think a lot of it is valid criticism.  I managed to unlock all the main girls for free with a whole bunch of effort and time, like a ridiculous amount. It's pretty easy to get what this game will be just from the splash panel. If you find the subject matter appealing and you enjoy clicker games, it's not a bad way to pass the time. Letting it idle for a while is more rewarding than just hammering away unless you're willing to pay real money for the in-game currency. The characters and drawings are cute and there are some fun storylines (including a murder). The NSFW mode is fun and inexpensive, and patience is definitely rewarded.

Returning after finishing the main storyline: I know it's a clicker, but there are some game mechanics that are incredibly frustrating, particularly gifts.

When you give gifts, you can't directly select the the required number. You're limited to 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 1K, 10K, 100K, and 1M. Getting to 1M requires 9 clicks. Add in having to navigate to the gift item through a multi-panel menu and it can be irritating to fulfill some of the gift requirements. In particular some of the optional characters require gift quantities of 10M or more. You have to give the gift a minimum of ten times. Annoying.
